headline: Housing committee weighs new criteria and shoreline conditions

meeting.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meeting.summary: Committee members proposed new criteria and shoreline conditions for two resolutions and planned a recess to research before voting.
meeting.recap: Draft criteria require most of a property's structures to be in a sea level rise, flood or shoreline setback area.[[0:36:42]] Paltin proposed a condition requiring public beach access from 8 a.m. to 10 p.m.[[0:44:43]] Paltin proposed requiring an updated state certified shoreline assessment for properties moving from apartment to hotel zoning.[[0:45:23]] Corporation counsel said zoning conditions must be clearly linked and proportional to the change's impact.[[0:51:10]] Another councilmember proposed a 25% test on 2008 unit records to show a property historically served visitors.[[0:59:06]] That councilmember proposed owners agree to remove buildings, pools and other human-made objects.[[1:00:34]] The chair said members would recess to do research and then come back to vote.[[1:03:27]]
meeting.next: Staff will send the proposed criteria and conditions to all members before the recess. Councilmember Sugimura asked staff to look at which properties the proposals would affect, and the chair said she plans to do that during a longer recess. After the recess, members plan to come back and vote.

moments.q: "We're not in a TVR crisis. We're in a housing crisis."
Paltin explains the state certified shoreline condition
Corporation counsel explains rational nexus for zoning conditions
Staff reads back Paltin's criterion and conditions

trackerIssues.title: Ending apartment vacation rentals and hotel rezoning of 48 properties

issues.oneLine: Members are weighing criteria and conditions for rezoning some apartment-zoned properties to hotel zoning.
issues.brief: Under the draft criteria, a property must not have been originally intended for affordable workforce housing.[[#1]] A councilmember proposed that properties with no more than 25% of units classified as homeowner or apartment in 2008 be treated as historically visitor lodging.[[#2]] Staff restated Paltin's criterion as Kīhei properties must be makai of South Kīhei Road to be included.[[#3]]
